turns.speaker: Wang Lung
turns.text: O-lan, you must not speak of these things, you are not thinking of yourself, you are thinking of our son's future and of our family's honor, you must not worry about what will happen to you, I will take care of everything.

turns.speaker: O-lan
turns.text: I will be dead soon, Wang Lung, and you must promise me that you will make sure our son is taken care of and married to a good woman, someone who will love him and care for him.

turns.speaker: the eldest son
turns.text: Mother, please don't worry about me, I will take care of myself, and Father will provide for me, but what about the maid? I have asked her to be my wife and she has agreed, but I want to make sure that you are happy with it too.

turns.speaker: Wang Lung
turns.text: I am already thinking of this, my son has asked the maid to be his wife and I have given my consent, she is a good girl and she will take care of you well, I promise O-lan

turns.speaker: O-lan
turns.text: I am glad that you have given your consent, Wang Lung, but I must see the maid for myself, I want to know that she will take care of my son and make him happy

turns.speaker: the eldest son
turns.text: Do not worry, Mother, I will bring the maid to you so you can see for yourself that she is a good woman, I promise.

turns.speaker: Wang Lung
turns.text: Do not worry, my son, I will take care of this, and I will bring the maid to you, so you can see for yourself that she will be good to you and your mother.

turns.speaker: O-lan
turns.text: I want to see the maid now, bring her to me, so I can know that she will take care of my son and make him happy.

turns.speaker: Wang Lung
turns.text: Do not worry, my wife, I will bring the maid to you now, so you can see for yourself that she is a good girl and worthy of our son

turns.speaker: O-lan
turns.text: I am tired, Wang Lung, but I must see this through, bring the maid to me now, so I can know that my son will be taken care of

turns.speaker: the eldest son
turns.text: Mother, do not worry about being tired, I will bring the maid to you right now, and you can see for yourself that she will take care of me and make me happy.

turns.speaker: O-lan
turns.text: I want to see the maid now, so I can know that my son will be taken care of, and I can rest easy, knowing he will be happy

turns.speaker: Wang Lung
turns.text: I will bring the maid to you right away, but first, let me take care of you, my wife, and give you some rest

turns.speaker: O-lan
turns.text: Bring her to me, Wang Lung, I must see her, and know that my son will be taken care of, before I go

turns.speaker: the eldest son
turns.text: Do not worry, Mother, I will bring the maid to you right away, and you can see for yourself how much I care for her, and how happy she will make me.

turns.speaker: the maid
turns.text: I will come, Mother-in-law, as soon as you call me, and I will do my best to take care of the Eldest Son, and bring him joy

turns.speaker: O-lan
turns.text: Please, bring her to me now, Wang Lung, I am too weak to wait much longer

turns.speaker: Wang Lung
turns.text: I will go and bring her to you, my wife, but you must rest and not exhaust yourself, you are not strong enough for this

turns.speaker: O-lan
turns.text: I will see her, Wang Lung, and know that she is good for my son, and that I can rest easy

turns.speaker: Wang Lung
turns.text: I will go and bring her to you now, my wife, and I will stay with you both until you are satisfied.

opening.text: Die I must, [GE-OMITTED:5:aa] [GE-OMITTED:6:aa] and well she serves me, [GE-OMITTED:7:aa] [GE-OMITTED:8:aa] because I must die, [GE-OMITTED:9:aa] [GE-OMITTED:10:aa] [GE-OMITTED:11:aa]

opening.text: [GE-OMITTED:40:aa] My son, [GE-OMITTED:41:aa] and my daughter, [GE-OMITTED:42:aa] there is she. [GE-OMITTED:43:aa]

opening.text: Well, and if I am ugly, [GE-OMITTED:50:aa] [GE-OMITTED:51:aa]
